title: G6 auto-calibrate on a coded/native session
symptom: After a preemptive restart of a coded G6, the user took a BG reading for a G5 on a second phone, and the primary phone handling the G6 sent that calibration to the G6, potentially sabotaging the code session. The user asks if coded sessions could be excluded from automatic calibration.
evidence_quote: could coded sessions be excluded from the "automatic calibration" license?
